# Solars — Solar Battery Management

> Platform for monitoring solar lithium-ion batteries and managing maintenance
> tickets on SLA (ITIL-aligned) for Admin, Manager, and Staff roles. Real-time
> battery health, State-of-Health (SOH) prediction, and anomaly detection.

## Pages

- [Home](https://solars.io.vn/): Product overview, features, and how the platform works.

## Notes

- The application dashboards (`/admin`, `/manager`, `/staff`) require
  authentication and are not publicly accessible.
